reviews.review_description: After much research I found it best to avoid the mass marketing Solar Companies as they're generally offering a specific package which they obviously have good buying power with specific solar equipment suppliers, but do not generally pass these savings on... If it sounds to good to be true it usually is...Case in point, one Solar supplier offered a $3000 saving via their Ad in local Newspaper, having quoted the actual price less the discount taken off the bottom line, they were still $4000 dollars more expensive than others (Solar Quote recommendations) within the price range of the 3kW system I was requesting quotes for.Be aware of actual performance characteristics (e.g. Temperature effects on Solar Panel performance & Inverter efficiency), because if you understand what you're getting you won't be disappointed. If you have a budget, try to get the best value for money products by researching the panels and Inverter which their are many options.Further more, follow the Tips, Hints and reviews on Solar Quotes and you'll be making sure you invest wisely and within your budget.

I had a brilliant quote (just over 17,000) for a 10 kW system with a three phase inverter, it was installed before Christmas with no fuss or bother.I can highly recommend Mundy Electrical PTY LTD to anyone looking for a solar system.

Excellent service from Mundy with support both before and after when needed.Installation was done without need to even be there and all the foot work before hand was also completed by Mundy.Customer service won the day and we have installed a system which meets our needs as requested. As said before, excellent!

All three companies that quoted were professional, would have been happy to go ahead with any one of them. Chose Mundys because I had full confidence in what Steve was telling me as he was going to be doing the install. Within 4 days of accepting the quote the system was up and running. The work carried out was top quality. Could not be happier with the whole process. We now have a new meter and are exporting more than we are importing.
